sloka: आददू रक्षसाम् प्राणान् पाशाः कालकृता इव ।भित्त्वा राक्षस देहान् ताम् ते शरा रुधिर आप्लुताः ॥३-२५-१९॥
transliteration: ādadū rakṣasām prāṇān pāśāḥ kālakṛtā iva ।bhittvā rākṣasa dehān tām te śarā rudhira āplutāḥ ॥3-25-19॥

translations.english: Rama's arrows pierced the bodies of the demons and drenched in blood, they, looking like burning fire, shone in the sky.
